summary.oneLiner: Damodar Industries Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer of high-quality cotton, melange, specialty, slub, multi-blend and value-added yarns for domestic and international apparel, home textile, knitting and fashion segments.
summary.business: Damodar Industries Limited manufactures a diversified portfolio of premium and value-added yarns, including cotton, melange, specialty, slub and multi-blend varieties. The Company serves both domestic and international markets, catering to apparel, home textiles, knitting and fashion applications. Backed by over four decades of experience, it focuses on product innovation, operational excellence and sustainable manufacturing through advanced spinning technologies and a dedicated R&D centre.
